subject: Mutual action workbook draft + 30-day eval slate
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Rios <evelyn.rios@heliumhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual action workbook draft + 30-day eval slate

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As promised, I attached a starter mutual-action workbook that lays out a compact 30-day evaluation plan and a proposed close timeline. The goal here is to make the first 30 days concrete so your engineering and security teams know what to expect.

Quick summary in the doc:
- Week 0: Kickoff, account access, and S3/KV samples for a focused test.
- Week 1–2: Integration (endpoints, token/throughput sanity checks), basic throughput demo with sample dataset.
- Week 3: Quality validation against patient-facing prompts (A/B eval).
- Week 4: Operational readiness, cost + SLA review, and exec sync.

Proposed close timeline: target contract signature by 2028-02-15 assuming no major compliance blockers.

Requests from our side (short list):
- A primary technical owner + SRE contact for access (read-only keys OK at first).
- Confirmation of SOC2 evidence window (or the preferred artifacts) for procurement.

Attachments: mutual-action-workbook-v1.gdoc (Google Doc stub), pricing-estimate-HeliumHealth.xlsx (xlsx stub).

If this looks good, can you share two 30–45m slots for a kickoff next week? I can loop in engineering owners once we lock a time.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stubs:
- mutual-action-workbook-v1.gdoc (Google Doc) — quick checklist, milestones, owners, and validation criteria
- pricing-estimate-HeliumHealth.xlsx (Excel) — preliminary unit economics for hosted vs. dedicated
From: Evelyn Rios <evelyn.rios@heliumhealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Helium Health Procurement <procurement@heliumhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 14:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action workbook draft + 30-day eval slate

Thanks Michael — this is helpful. A couple quick notes from procurement and security before we lock the kickoff: 

- Procurement: can you confirm what standard terms you would expect for a 12-month committed plan vs a pilot? We may want to see a short-term pilot pricing line-item in the workbook.
- Security: the SOC2 artifacts we require are SOC2 type II report (last 12 months) and a list of data retention/erase procedures. Can you point me to where we can get those or share a stub?

Also looping in our technical lead, Marcus Lee (m.leee@heliumhealth.com) for availability — Marcus, can you confirm whether a read-only dataset for initial throughput tests (anonymized) is feasible this week?

Availability for kickoff: Tue Jan 16 after 1pm PT or Wed Jan 17 morning.

Best,
Evelyn Rios
Head of Product Operations
Helium Health

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Rios <evelyn.rios@heliumhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Helium Health Procurement <procurement@heliumhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jan 2028 08:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action workbook draft + 30-day eval slate

Evelyn — appreciate the quick read. Short answers below, and I updated the workbook with a pilot pricing line near the top.

- Terms: pilot pricing (30d) is listed as a fixed not-to-exceed; committed 12-month pricing is shown as a monthly committed rate with a 20% uplift for dedicated capacity option. Exact contract language and options we can surface as redlines once you confirm preferred path.
- SOC2: we host SOC2 type II artifacts in our security portal. I attached a short SOC2 evidence packet link in the doc and included the ProcSec contact (sec-requests@redwood.com) for any formal requests. If you need a signed NDA first, we can do that; otherwise the high-level artifact is in the Drive link.

Drive + HubSpot references: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c4d-mrw-workbook-draft (workbook draft), HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/582910/HW-2026-1192

Proposed kickoff: Wed Jan 17 — we have a 9:30–10:15am PT slot open that day. If that works for Marcus and procurement, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short agenda (tech objectives + acceptance criteria + timelines).

Also added an internal owner column in the workbook: 
- Integration owner: Jordan Blake (eng point)
- Pilot ops/CS owner: Marissa Cole

Thanks — happy to walk through the workbook live in the kickoff.

Best,
Michael
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
